text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm walking through the
Tracen
Academy school building...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Zoinks!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: P-pard'n me! I was just spac'n out a bit...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-you could tell just by look'n?
choice_data_list: 浮かない顔だな、どうした？
浮かない顔だね、どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, actually, some folks from my
hometown are
pay'n me a visit soon.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We're hav'n a scrimmage, so they said
they'd
come t'cheer me on...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm pleased as punch about them
com'n,
but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The race is gonna have Oguri and all
kinds of
talented racers running in it, so I
don't know how
well I'll be able t'do.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
They're com'n from so far away to cheer
me on... I
just hope I don't disappoint
them...

Even if Yukino Bijin's concerns are
warranted,
letting her anxieties get the
better of her would
defeat the purpose
of the race. But just as about
I'm about
to tell her this...

What's this?! My class rep senses detect
a worried
student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yukino! So YOU'RE the source of the
distress
signal!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You can't fool your class representative!
If
something's on your mind, then TALK
TO ME!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! I understand your concerns very
well...
VERY WELL INDEED!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As everyone's class representative, I will
train you
myself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To win a race, all you've gotta do is
train! You
there! Trainer! You're with me,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To win a race, all you've gotta do is
train! You
there! Trainer! You're with me,
right?!

text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O's perpetual boldness
is
definitely a strength of hers in races as
well.

text_block_list.text:
With a little of that tenacity, Yukino
Bijin might
be able to race to the best of
her abilities
regardless of who she's up
against. I explain this
to her, and...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You're right! My nerves've gotten the
better of
me in a bunch of past races! I
couldn't even run
properly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then you really do need your class

representative to help you out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
With that settled, let's head over to the
perfect
training spot!

Although Sakura Bakushin O is full of
confidence,
a sense of unease compels
me to tag along with
them.

Sakura Bakushin O brings us out to the
central
plaza.

A reporter from a magazine is
interviewing
students passing by.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Special Feature: Word from Tracen
Academy!"
Let's have them interview us
too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your training begins NOW, Yukino! If
you can
answer the questions with
confidence here, then
you've surely got
grit worthy of a class rep too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My running philosophy? Well, it's to set
a good
example and run each race in a
manner worthy of
a class representative!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-as for me, um... it'd be nice if I looked
as cool
as the others when I run...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! I sense that you're holding
back,
Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You need to reveal more of your inner
feelings!
Don't you want to bring honor
to your
hometown?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: My hometown...

text_block_list.name: Older Lady
text_block_list.text:
Give it your all, Yukino! Show those city
racers
what you can do!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for com'n to see me off, everyone! You've even made a snazzy bann'r for me... Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become a real strong
Umamusume! One
you'll all be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(That's right... I wanna show 'em I've
become a
city girl too!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run a race that'll make all the
folks from
my hometown real proud!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna show them all that I can shine
just as
bright as the city girls!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe, now that was an interview! You fully expressed how you feel about your hometown and racing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I remembered someth'n important back
there...
and I guess it gave me the
courage I needed!

Sakura Bakushin O's spirited running and

perfectly timed bursts of speed are
amazing.

I tell Yukino that if she can learn from
Bakushin
O's running, her strategy
repertoire will expand,
giving her the
edge in races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! EXACTLY! You've got a
real
discerning eye on you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Leave everything to me! Starting today,
your
running abilities will be class
rep-level too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Z-zowie, sounds like I'll be a force to be
reck'ned
with... Thanks so much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It's all in a day's work for a
class
representative! All right! Get
changed and I'll see
you at the track!

Although Sakura Bakushin O is full of
confidence,
a sense of unease compels
me to tag along with
them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's start with some

class-representative-style SHUTTLE
RUNS!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
While running back and forth, we shout
energetic
phrases at the top of our
lungs! This lets us muster
more energy
and speed than normal!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: R-really? Okay, um...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Rock 'n roll!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! And remember, you're
competing
with my gusto as well!

And with that, Yukino Bijin and Sakura
Bakushin
O push through their
class-representative-style
training.

While a lot of the training exercises
come out of
left field, they all help
Yukino Bijin to learn
Sakura Bakushin
O's running style.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huff... wheeze... All that's left is the final exercise to wrap things up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... gasp... Y-you're right. Let's take a break.
choice_data_list: いったん休んだ方がいいぞ
いったん休んだ方がいいよ

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's pretty impressive that you
managed to
keep up with my training
exercises!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... well, you did a tee-rific job of
teach'n me
your runn'n style!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, time for the final training
exercise! Run
however you please
toward the setting sun!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sweating and gritting your teeth while
showing
real guts... A class
representative must embody
the spirit of
youth!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If you set your heart aflame with that
fiery
fighting spirit you've gained, you'll
be able to win
any race!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I see! I think I've seen a scene like that in
a TV
show rerun!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll be just like the characters in that
show... All
right! Time to rock 'n roll!
